about: The contract of the transcript repair (knowledge::repair::propose). The speech work reuses this file as it is. 'known_names' are the people the knowledge base holds (the test writes one document for each, with a title and the full name, so that each is a confirmed name). 'must_propose' are transcripts where a word must be proposed as a known name: 'heard' is the word or run as the engine wrote it, 'expected' the names offered (best first), 'action' is 'suggest' (one strong candidate) or 'ask' (several, or a spelling-only match). 'must_not_change' are transcripts that must get no proposal at all: ordinary words, months, a name that is already a known name. 'cases_without_case' are read with case_reliable = false: only a word that follows a title is looked at. Names are invented; none is a real person.

must_propose.transcript: J'ai croise Dupond au cabinet ce matin
Le courrier de Lefèvre est pret

must_not_change: Le pont est ferme ce matin
Rendez-vous en Janvier ou en Mars
